notes.content:

To all victims of the “Limb-Severing Devil Case,” please forgive this sudden announcement!
The Summer of Terror Isn't Over Yet!

[h3]Starting September 2nd, “Anime Game Festival 2025” will be featured on Steam, and I am thrilled to announce that “Severed Love” will be participating!
To celebrate our participation, I've decided to extend the availability of our fully voiced demo version![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45515129/30c3c3f3c66855a577e72752ad412106c56a5365.png[/img]

[h2]【Anime Game Festival 2025 Steam Feature Page】[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Neverland/sale/AnimeGameFestival2025


[h3]Thanks to the many people who experienced this game this summer, Steam wishlist registrations have surpassed 【5555】![/h3]

At the previous “East Asia Indie Games Celebration,” over 400 indie games participated, including many well-known titles.
So my game might not have stood out, but I've still been able to steadily increase the number of wishlist additions.

I can only hope that the next Steam featured page will help even more people learn about The “Limb-Severing Devil Case”!

You can still post reviews even during the extended demo period.
Even just a few words would be appreciated! If you enjoyed this game, I'd love your support through a review!

notes.title: Wish list has over 5000 registrations and 20 reviews of the demo version!
notes.content:
[h1]【Thank you for 5000 wishlist registrations!】[/h1]
[previewyoutube=pacSHO1SPRw;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]I reached 5,000 wish list registrations on July 19 and 20 reviews of the demo version on August 4![/h3]

This is the first time I have received so many registrations, almost double the previous record high.

Although the rest of the world is too disturbing to be honestly happy about it, such as the search-ban on my X (Twitter) account and the restrictions on expression that are often talked about around here, I am able to aim a little higher on Steam.

At the same time, it has been about 5 months since the opening of the Steam Store page, and the speed of time is very frightening...but there has been progress besides this trial version update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45515129/5e33ef385cfc98d9d1abba46f5c88e9e09bb44e3.gif[/img]

The Live2D in the YouTube commemorative video is a new model that seamlessly turns right side out.

I am also currently working on a profile Live2D model of the main character.
Once this is completed, development of the main story will make great progress!

By using different Live2D models with different angles, I would like to greatly expand the scope of the production, such as increasing the number of situations where two people are facing each other in different compositions or situations that are comparable to stills.
(This would make it more [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2106840/_FILE23/]PARANORMASIGHT[/url]-like...)

I am posting the progress of the new Live2D model on the official Discord server as fast as possible.
I hope you will check it out along with our SNS!

[h1]【About English Translation of the Demo Version】[/h1]
I have received several comments that the English translation, which was updated in the August update, is not natural.

The English scenarios were machine-translated and proofread, but as a private developer with a limited budget, I could not say that I spent enough money on the translation.
I am very sorry if anyone was not able to enjoy the demo version.

[h3]I am considering completely revamping the English translation for the full product version, including the scenario for the demo version portion.[/h3]
However, the market price for English translation is high, and to be honest, it is not affordable for an individual.

I need to start by looking for a publisher, but the recent winds of restrictions on expression may be a headwind...

Your support is essential to make this happen!
You can support us by registering your Steam Wish List or submitting a review of the demo version.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3572980/_Demo/

I may also need the help of volunteers who are willing to do fan translations.

I am developing this game in Unity, and I am looking to create an environment that is more conducive to fan translation without the need to extract text data.

If you are interested in fan translation, whether in English or any other language, I would love to hear from you through the Steam community!

[*]『Severed Love』Steam Community： [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3412110/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/3412110/[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fix update for demo version
notes.content:
Thank you to all the victims of the “Limb-Severing Devil Case” who are enjoying the full voice demo version!

I have fixed a bug that caused the game to become inaccessible in some countries.
If you could not play the game properly, please try updating the game.

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the background of the panorama search part to go completely dark in some countries, such as Europe and Russia, making progress impossible.
Specifically, this bug applies to "regions where decimal points are denoted with commas".
[*] When simplified or traditional Chinese characters are selected in the language setting, the “小红书(RED)” button is now displayed in the chapter select link.
[*] The number of situations where the skip is forced to be canceled has been reduced to ensure smooth skipping.
Normally, skipping is forced to be canceled for choices and the panorama exploration part. It is possible to change the setting to “Do not unskip at choices” in the configuration.
[*] Fixed other minor bugs and typos.
[/list]
[b]Our sincere thanks to those who have helped me to determine the cause of the bug![/b]

The English version of the game has also been updated with a teaser movie, a play movie, screenshots, and a video introducing the character editing feature.
Two new screenshots of the new features have been added in other languages.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3572980/_Demo/

[previewyoutube=rapUwP7uA8M;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45515129/babaf417522b75e7a2cf7de199e92b874dffa852.png[/img]
A new system flowchart has also been added that allows you to resume from your favorite scene.
This feature makes it easier to collect scenes of the protagonist's death in game over.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45515129/2dbf41a2bbbb6c5099f46e53f6c6e0f4bdce5f0a.png[/img]
In chapter select, special dialogue can occur under certain conditions, and certain operations can be used to view exclusive Live2D motion only available here.

[h3]The demo version on Steam will also allow live game streaming.[/h3]
I have also prepared image materials that can be used as thumbnails!
You can download them for free at BOOTH.
https://zakurosuke.booth.pm/items/6856424


[h1]Official Discord server opened![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45515129/60293fb53fc378a6814b410b68620e7dacd097d1.png[/img]
[h3]I have officially opened a fan Discord server for “Severed Love”, “Romp of Dump” and other [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/42320474]ZAKUROBENTO productions[/url]![/h3]

[h2]Click here to join:  [url=https://discord.gg/dsrZGJhc49]https://discord.gg/dsrZGJhc49[/url][/h2]

I will provide the following support to the Association of Victims of the “Limb-Severing Devil Case”.
[list]
[*] Be the first to receive game updates and other information
[*] Development progress not yet posted on SNS
[*] Live streaming to see developing scenes in real time
[*] Daily reports on Steam wishlist (!?)
[*] Communicate with developers by asking questions
[*] Post feedback and fan art and interact with other fans
[/list]
The main language of the server will be Japanese, but you can communicate with the developers via machine translation.
The rule descriptions and channel overviews have also been translated into English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean, although the translations are machine-translated.

I welcome people who are not chatty!
There is no voice chat on the server. I will not force you to greet or communicate with anyone.

This will be a community that is updated more frequently than a social networking site.
Please join the server and keep an eye on the criminal plans of the “Limb-Severing Devil Case”!


[h1]Started a Chinese-language social networking site, “小紅書 (RED)”![/h1]
I have also opened a new account, “小紅書 (RED)”, to make more people aware of the threat of the “Limb-Severing Devil Case”.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45515129/ef6a852e8998ceedfd83b756e068ac1b76c635b0.jpg[/img]
[h2]Click here to follow: [url=https://www.xiaohongshu.com/user/profile/688c891d0000000028026604?xh=]rednote ID《zakurobento》[/url][/h2]

I will be posting in both Simplified and Traditional Chinese.
...But as a Japanese developer, I am naturally starting from scratch and don't know what's right and left.

I would appreciate your cooperation in spreading the word to all Chinese speakers!
If you follow me, the obsession of the “Limb-Shaving Devil” will be directed at you as well...


[h1]A recent situation called adversity[/h1]
Around late May, [url=https://x.com/zakurobento]my X (Twitter) account[/url], which has been my main source of information, went into a serious search-ban.

Impressions have decreased dramatically, as posts are no longer caught in searches and warnings are forced to appear even on healthy images and videos.
I have had to refrain from posting illustrations and other content in order to get the searchban lifted, and have lost most of my opportunities to spread the word.

I have never posted or spread extreme language or adult content on social networking sites, but I regret that I should have operated more carefully because “Severed Love” is also a bizarre and explicit work.
(By the way, I am bad at adult content...)

I would like to make “Severed Love” not an instant freak show, but a work with a deep theme that includes the anguish of a limb-slasher with a missing body, mind, and sexuality, and the irony of the fetishists who see it through the screen (i.e., us).
However, there was no way that the AI of X (Twitter) would understand this...


Just the other day, there was an uproar over the exclusion of NSFW content on itch.io.
(Fortunately, [url=https://zakurosuke.itch.io/severedlove]the demo version of “Severed Love” that was published on itch.io[/url] was not subject to the restrictions.)

Steam wishlist registrations are going well so far, which motivates developers, but you never know when restrictions will get tighter, even on Steam.

I have been mentally trapped, especially in the wake of the X (Twitter) searchban, and have been mentally and physically unstable for over two months.

Should “missing limb” games and the developers who want to create them not exist?
There is not a day that goes by that I don't wonder about this.

[i]“I'm so tired.”
“Why am I doing this?”[/i]

The Limb-Severing Devil messed-up statements are the same words I am always eager to shout.
(If I post them on social media, I get unfollowed or search-banned, so I need a character from my own work to speak for me to keep me sane!)

I don't know how many times now, but I seem to be linked to his state of mind at the best of times. And just like that, I am also making a crazy game!

[h3]To those of you who are looking forward to “Severed Love”, please help me![/h3]

It would be a great help if you could send us your support through our newly opened official Discord server, various social networking sites, and the Steam community.

X (Twitter) would also appreciate replies and likes on our daily posts as I would like to remove the searchban and resume announcements.

notes.title: New system character customization of protagonist & demo version release notice!
notes.content:
[h1]【New system “Character customization of the protagonist” added!】[/h1]
[h3]Taking advantage of Live2D, I have added a new system that allows you to change the customization of the protagonist![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45515129/dfc15d8cc3c01a1ef65e6844ebb25410be652aab.png[/img]
You can choose your hairstyle (bangs, sideburns, back hair), eyes, and eyebrows from about 3 different patterns.

Bob cut, Hairstyle that hides the eyes, boyish... You can make your protagonist more feminine or, conversely, more neutral.
Take the look you prefer and tell the Limb-Severing Devil to “go to hell”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45515129/5185ffcb2a78cc58beea2d08c017d393f4b0cba8.gif[/img]
The changed appearance is reflected not only in the standing picture but also in the event CG, which is animated in Live2D!
(However, this situation is also expressed by changing the pose of the usual standing picture, so I haven't drawn any stills yet, but because of... I was able to achieve this at low cost!)

Please check out the introductory video on the Steam store page to see the actual gameplay.
(The video is at the very back of the screenshots section!)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3412110/_/

[b]I have decided to remove the “gender selection system” for languages other than Japanese, replacing it with a character customization system.[/b]
I would appreciate your understanding in this matter.

The reason for this is that there are many users who want to enjoy Otome games with a female protagonist without worry, and I felt that this should be taken into consideration.

By implementing a more flexible character customization system, I hope to make this game accessible to all kinds of users, including those who like orthodox Otome games, those who value diversity, those who want to strengthen their self-projection, and men who want to love the character of their choice.

Only in Japanese, the ability to choose the first person of the protagonist will continue to be implemented!

The scenario is still the same, with no reference to the gender identity of the protagonist.
You can rest assured that I will not make any assumptions about your gender based on your appearance.

In addition, I can imagine the following requests for a character customization system...
[list]
[*] I want more patterns.
[*] I want to change hair color, eye color, and skin color.
[*] I want to change my costume.
[/list]Character customization in this work is only a simplified version, and is unlikely to be expanded further.
[b]I am sorry, but I am not going to be able to do this, because it would stop the development of the full-length version of the game![/b]

[list]
[*] I want to change the appearance of my love interest, the “Limb-Severing Devil”.
[/list]In particular, I do not intend to implement this one.
[b]He is, after all, a character that the developer likes![/b]
I would be happy if those who like him as he is could become victims of the “Limb-Severing Devil Case”.

However, I sometimes think to myself that I would be happy to have at least some accessories such as glasses...
If you have any comments about the character customization system, please let us know in the Steam community!
https://steamcommunity.com/app/3412110/discussions/

notes.title: The Steam Store page for “Severed Love” is now available!
notes.content:
[h3]You have lost both your legs and arms and you can’t remember anything...
The Limb-Severing Devil's Confinement and Devotion.
Your only way to survive... Pretend to be his lover,[/h3]

[previewyoutube=0jS-B4yhlVQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]...So today I have released information about our new game “Severed Love”.
I have released the teaser movie and character voices along with the Steam store page![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3412110/_/
[h3]Please register your wish list![/h3]
Register on our wish list to receive information about releases and sales.

(This notice uses machine translation.)


In “Severed Love”, the developer, who had previously hidden his true nature and made [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1951520/Romp_of_Dump/]a game with nothing but scruffy men[/url], is now bravely opening up his fetishism to the fullest and making a game with nothing but scruffy men again!(?)

In fact, even though I make Otome games, I have never played most of the commercial Otome games.
It seems that the popular Otome games are not to my taste.

So I decided to create “Severed Love” with this concept in mind, not only for Otome game players who like Yandere, but also for women like me who find it hard to live in the world of Otome games.
[list]
[*] Really what I'm looking for is a game with limb-deficient characters for women.
[*] Otome game that focuses on the story, not spoiled doting.
[*] Not just a visual novel with standing pictures, but an Otome game with a focus on presentation
[*] Male love interest with no direct connection between romantic feelings and sexual desire.
(I was not a fan of the male love interests in Otome games who tend to say “I'm a guy too” in the end.)
[*] A protagonist who is forgiven for not being a good girl.
(I want to be able to choose between stereotypical heroine images and dewy-eyed behavior, without forcing either.)
[*] Moderately dry relationships between characters, cowardly and distorted but sympathetic way of life.
(I would like to give this game to those who are tired of the sparkling bonds that are often found in games for women other than Otome games.)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45515129/852bc300662928f1e67ebfeb87e3ef036d5af7dc.png[/img]
...Do you think a man who says “I want to stop confinement” is just depressed and not a yandere?
That's a fair point, but there is actually a secret to his emotional instability and the reason why he cares for you while he keeps you locked up.
I will do our best to develop the game so that you can find out about it in the full game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45515129/98f0be2fd675313097597e359a53ffca0a78806d.png[/img]
